value.rationale: A canonical sparse cycle election, two approvals per voter, exposes an exact full score spectrum under all sequential PAV tie resolutions and a globally sharp uniform 11/12 performance guarantee, substantially stronger and more informative than generic submodular approximation. Infinite equality families and a gap-based structural characterization explain when and why tie-breaking loses welfare.
